column3: “Draw near to yourself” is rendered “Keep to yourself,” and “I am set apart” as “I am holier.”
“Your iniquities” is rendered “their own iniquities,” and “first” is rendered “former.”
“Fortune … Destiny” renders the deity names Gad and Meni.
“The God of surely” (amen) is rendered “the God of truth,” and “blesses himself” as “is blessed.”
